title: Sticker Mule: Software engineer
description_review: Fully remote full-stack role at Sticker Mule offering $150k-$250k USD plus $20k signing bonus across 40+ countries. The tech stack uses Go, TypeScript, React, Expo, GraphQL, and Postgres on GCP, shipping web and mobile apps. Requires aggressive AI usage in daily workflows to build internal and consumer-facing tools.
pros: High compensation ($150k-$250k USD) and fully remote international availability
Agile product ownership and strong emphasis on applied AI usage align with candidate profile
TypeScript and PostgreSQL match secondary technical stack
cons: Core stack is Go and React/Expo rather than Java and Spring Boot
E-commerce creator tooling domain differs from banking, fintech, and enterprise modernization

title: A.Team: Senior Independent AI Engineer / Architect
description_review: Remote contract network role (Americas, Europe, Israel) with A.Team for senior AI architects and engineers building production systems. Focuses on agent architectures, orchestration frameworks, enterprise AI deployments, and LLM reliability infrastructure. Engagements involve working directly with startup founders and enterprise CTOs to ship production AI solutions.
pros: Agent architectures and orchestration systems directly match candidate's multi-agent platform and modernization harness work
Enterprise AI deployment scope leverages candidate's senior software architecture and enterprise background
Remote availability across Americas and Europe accommodates candidate location
cons: Talent network marketplace / freelance contract structure rather than permanent full-time employment

title: A.Team: Senior Independent Software Developer ($90-$170/hr)
description_review: Remote invite-only network role with A.Team offering $90-$170/hr for senior software developers on high-impact projects. Small autonomous teams build ambitious greenfield software and scale enterprise platforms for venture-backed startups and enterprises. Designed for senior engineers from large corporate backgrounds seeking autonomous mission-based work.
pros: Competitive hourly rate ($90-$170/hr) with full autonomy on project selection
Targeting senior developers exiting large enterprises matches 7+ years corporate banking background
High-impact distributed system and product architecture opportunities
cons: Marketplace/contract-based model without guaranteed ongoing salary
No specific mention of Java, Spring Boot, or core AI agent toolsets in the overview listing

title: Frontend Engineer at Bjak
description_review: Remote frontend engineer role at Bjak (ActAI) based in Ireland building AI-native productivity apps such as chat, notes, calendar, and sheets. Focuses heavily on frontend UI architecture, real-time messaging, streaming AI responses, and rich text editors. Heavy web client specialization collaborating with backend and AI engineers.
pros: Work with streaming AI responses and proactive agent workflows aligns with applied AI interests
Candidate possesses frontend experience in TypeScript and Angular/Vue
cons: Pure frontend engineering role mismatches the candidate's core backend/Java/Spring strengths
Location listed in Ireland with unclear global remote eligibility

title: AI agent engineer at Sticker Mule
description_review: Fully remote AI agent engineer role at Sticker Mule offering $150k-$250k USD plus a $20k signing bonus. Entails building, managing, and connecting autonomous AI agent teams to third-party and internal systems using Claude, OpenAI, Grok, and open-source models. The technical environment leverages Go, TypeScript, GraphQL, Postgres, and GCP.
pros: Autonomous AI agent engineering and orchestration directly maps to candidate's multi-agent platform and harness development
Excellent compensation ($150k-$250k USD + $20k bonus) and global remote structure
Strong hands-on application of modern LLMs and agent tool use
cons: Codebase uses Go, TypeScript, and GraphQL rather than Java/Spring Boot core backend
E-commerce manufacturing domain rather than banking or financial services
